title: RISE Changes: a checked brand record for the figure kit
acceptance: A brand is data only: a name and three #RRGGBB colors (ground, ink, accent); any other key, a short hex, a color name or markup is refused with a plain sentence. No SVG, font, CSS or code is accepted.

renderFigure(spec, { brand }) draws each of the six kinds in the brand's ink and accent on a ground the figure carries itself, with the kit's own geometry and type sizes; every label is set in the brand's ink at full strength (the owner's call, 2026-10-27), where a theme softens notes and details; a theme and a brand together are refused.
The brand's name is its wordmark: set by the kit's own escaping text function at label size above the title, in the brand's ink, and refused with its budget when it does not fit the width.

A brand is refused, with its ratio, when any color a label is set in falls under the layout check's 4.5:1 on what it is set on: the ink on the ground, the accent on the ground and on its tint behind a changed step. Nothing is tinted to make a brand pass.
Every figure the kit draws in an admitted brand is admitted and layout-clean, down to the lightest ink the check admits.
Each kind in one light brand (Northwind: #FFFFFF, #1A1A1A, #0B57D0) is pinned as a golden SVG under src/core/figures/fixtures, so the brand's figures can be looked at in review.

Each brand RISE draws in for a customer is a reviewed file entry (src/core/figures/brands.js) with its six kinds pinned as goldens, and is marked confirmed only once the company approves its colors. GitHits is the first, provisional: ground #13161A, ink #D5D9DF, accent #FF4FAE, sampled from a screenshot of githits.com and not yet confirmed by GitHits.

activity.summary: Opened from the owner's brand record direction (step 1 of 4: the slot and the contrast refusal).
Full ink for brands and the wordmark (owner calls). GitHits added as the first brand, provisional until GitHits confirms its colors; no run in it until then.

summary: The six kinds take a checked brand with its name as a wordmark above the title, set every label in its ink at full strength, and refuse a brand that fails contrast. GitHits is the first brand, provisional until GitHits confirms its colors. Not wired into the digest or the public workflow yet.
